stack: Jekyll 3.10 via GitHub Pages with Minimal Mistakes remote theme

pages._pages/home.md: Homepage content for the custom Hero, About, Selected, and Contact layout.
pages._pages/now.md: Informal side page for current interests.
pages._pages/404.html: Error page moved into the included pages directory.
pages._posts: Long-form posts are preserved locally and excluded from this homepage build.

assets.assets/images/about.jpg: Supplied 300x400 portrait, subject looking right; used left of hero copy.

design_system: Minimal Mistakes provides the base structure; project tokens and layouts live in _sass, _layouts, and design.md.
risks: GitHub Pages user sites require an empty baseurl
the remote theme needs network access during a clean local build
the unpublished posts directory must stay excluded until the blog is ready
new homepage copy may need later personal revision
preserve: the user’s unpublished post outside this commit
